items.title: Tether tapped by Kazakhstan’s central bank to explore stablecoin and tokenization
items.summary: The National Bank of Kazakhstan said it will study a local currency-linked stablecoin and tokenized real-world assets with Tether.

items.title: Tether, Kazakhstan cenbank mull tenge stablecoin and asset tokenization
items.summary: The agreement will explore a tenge-backed stablecoin pilot and a framework for tokenizing real-world assets as Kazakhstan expands its digital asset industry.

items.title: House Finance panel chair says regulator actions on crypto ‘fall short’ of CLARITY bill
items.summary: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
items.summary: Sepolia marks one of the final major rehearsals before the final activation of Glamsterdam, aimed at bringing more efficiency and scalability to the Ethereum mainnet.

items.title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
items.summary: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

items.title: SEC Clears 3x Leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds for Trading
items.summary: The agency approved a Cboe rule letting six Volatility Shares funds that triple the daily moves of Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, silver, oil, and natural gas list on a U.S. exchange.

items.title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
items.summary: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.
